data.narrative:
Echodyne is a Series C defense & security company that has raised $224M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 13 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, including 8 private companies (Quantum-Systems, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and others) and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer universe spans valuations from $300M to $18.0B, with a median of $2.1B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline of $224M and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $381M. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company set yields $2.1B, reflecting the broad range and concentration of late-stage valuations in the defense sector. The two methods produce materially different signals, with peer comps skewed higher by several Series D outliers including Helsing at $18.0B and Saronic at $9.2B.

The triangulated range spans $324M (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide dispersion reflects genuine uncertainty around whether Echodyne's technology, market position, and go-to-market trajectory align with top-quartile peers like Quantum-Systems ($8.0B) or lower-quartile equivalents. Stage-progression suggests conservatism; peer median suggests expansion potential. Key variables include customer traction in defense procurement, recurring revenue profile, and capital efficiency relative to the peer set.
